prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a parking lot collision. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1053; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent with cervical strain. Over the course of 29 visits, care consisted of conservative management including manual therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. Treatment progressed along a typical recovery pattern, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and range of motion increased. Examination revealed reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal tenderness that support the reported injury, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing remained within normal limits. The mechanism of injury is reasonably consistent with the reported symptoms. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical spine is known to this provider. Billing records reflect single, appropriately spaced charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries. At discharge, the patient was improving and was advised to continue independent home exercise as needed.
